description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for LDAP service, specifically testing anonymous bind connections and connection failures with invalid host and port configurations within the LDAP authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class extending KernelTestCase, tests LDAP anonymous connection and failure scenarios with invalid host, port, and encryption settings.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Class setup method to check LDAP server configuration before running tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Test setup method to configure LDAP server and load fixture data once.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings, enables anonymous binding, sets page size, and loads fixture users.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests if an anonymous LDAP connection can be successfully established.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Verifies that connection to an invalid LDAP host raises a ConnectionException with the message 'Can't contact LDAP server'.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Verifies that connection to an invalid LDAP port raises a ConnectionException with the message 'Can't contact LDAP server'.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests connection with SSL encryption on LDAP, expects failure with ContactException.
